Real-recording audition · review only

DON'T KNOCK BACK

Three candidates built only from real recordings: a prepared piano, a cello, and the two together. None of them is in the game yet, and nothing in the game has changed. Play them one at a time with Loop on and let each one wrap at least once.

PrototypeThese are built from Freesound's public HQ previews (lossy MP3, 44.1 kHz), not the original WAVs, so expect slightly soft highs and some MP3 grain. If one is chosen, it gets rebuilt from the lossless original before it goes anywhere near the game.

Measured from the files on this page — ogg: 108.83 s, -24.0 LUFS, LRA 10.2 LU, -3.4 dBTP · m4a: 108.83 s, -24.0 LUFS, -3.4 dBTP

Only one cue plays at a time. For each one, tell me: whine — any thin high tone or ringing that gets on your nerves? repetition — could you hear where it loops or repeats? naturalness — does it sound like a real instrument in a room, or edited? tension — does it make the house feel wrong, or is it just pleasant? And preference — which of the three would you rather hear in the game, if any. “Piano good, strings whiny, combo too busy” is plenty.
